title: test: frontend unit tests with 95% coverage gate
body:
## Summary
Adds a Jest + React Testing Library unit-test suite for the Next.js frontend and enforces a **95% coverage gate** in CI. Mirrors the backend testing setup from #21. **72 tests**, all green.

**Coverage (all thresholds met):**
```
Statements : 99%    (199/201)
Branches   : 95.71% (67/70)    threshold 85%
Functions  : 100%   (49/49)
Lines      : 99.47% (188/189)  threshold 95%
```

**Scope of the gate.** Coverage is collected from the logic-bearing and primitive modules — `src/lib`, `src/hooks`, `src/contexts`, `src/components/ui` — via `collectCoverageFrom`. The route pages (`src/app/**`), layout shells, and recharts-based dashboard widgets are presentational/integration surfaces (already exercised by the live end-to-end testing in earlier PRs) and are intentionally out of the unit-coverage scope rather than padded with shallow render tests.

**What changed**
- `frontend/jest.config.js` — `next/jest` preset, `jsdom` env, `@/*` module mapper, `coverageThreshold` global `{ lines: 95, statements: 95, functions: 95, branches: 85 }`.
- `frontend/jest.setup.ts` — imports `@testing-library/jest-dom`.
- `frontend/test/` — tests for:
  - `lib/utils` (formatters, `getInitials`, `getStatusColor`), `lib/api` (token resolution, header/body construction for GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), `lib/supabase`.
  - `hooks/useNotice` (timer-based auto-dismiss, re-flash reset) and `hooks/useApiData` (success / API-failure / network-throw / disabled / refetch).
  - `contexts/AuthContext` — mount bootstrap (token present/absent, public vs protected path), `login`/`register`/`logout` success+failure+throw paths, `clearError`, and the out-of-provider guard.
  - `components/ui` — `Badge`, `EmptyState`, `StatsCard`, `Notice`, `Modal` (Esc + body-scroll lock), `DataTable` (empty state, custom renderers, row click).
  - All boundaries mocked: `fetch`, `next/navigation`, `@/lib/api`, `@supabase/ssr`.
- CI: new `Test frontend (95% coverage gate)` step running `npm run test:coverage`.
